title: Siege of Shimoda
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Shimoda", at revision 1370745219, opens: "The siege of Shimoda was a naval siege conducted against a coastal Hōjō fortress in Izu Province, part of Odawara Campaign." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2500644, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "in Shimoda, Shizuoka". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
